After breakfast, transfer to Buenos Aires airport for your flight to Lima. The flight has a connection.

On arrival, meet your driver and transfer to your hotel.

Lima marks the transition from South America’s major cities and waterfalls to the high-altitude part of your journey through Peru.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, explore Lima with an English-speaking guide.

Your route takes you through the historic centre. You will see the Main Square with the Cathedral, the Convent of San Francisco and buildings with carved wooden balconies.

You then continue through the residential districts. In San Isidro, you will find an olive grove, a golf course and quiet streets of low-rise buildings.

In Miraflores, you will visit the Park of Love on the cliffs above the Pacific Ocean. The park has mosaics, and its design recalls Park Güell in Barcelona. Your route then continues through the Central Park, the City Hall and Avenida Larco, with its shops and cafés.

The day also includes a visit to the Larco Museum.

Return to your hotel after the tour.
